ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low white-to-black ratio; approximately 98% of the visible surface consists of low-intensity black pixels, with high-intensity pixels limited to localized flecks and distal calcifications.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous dark-field mapping across both lobes; small, high-contrast white punctate blobs are mapped at the apex of the median notch and near the central water-line intersection.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch; calculated internal angle of approximately 55-60 degrees with a significant vertical depth relative to the fluke's horizontal width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (2-5 pixel variation) along the medial trailing edge, transitioning to larger, irregular peaks and valleys (8-15 pixel variation) toward the distal lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave trajectory on the inner trailing edge leading to a sharp upward convex sweep at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Massive, high-density clusters of high-intensity, textured pixel groupings (barnacles) concentrated at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; secondary smaller clusters visible along the outer trailing edge periphery.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Subtle, vertically oriented linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) detected on the medial-to-distal section of the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme peripheral accumulation of sessile barnacles on both tips causing structural distortion of the fluke silhouette; irregular nicks and non-uniform serrations on the trailing edge indicative of mechanical wear.
other_distinctive_markers: The volume of distal barnacle colonization is highly distinctive, creating a bulbous, cauliflower-like texture on the extreme edges of the lobes.
